children: Russia is set to export pig iron from the Arctic port of Murmansk for the first time in 30 years, avoiding shipping routes in the Black Sea region targeted by Ukraine and adjusting cargo transport channels. According to Sina Finance, the port posted a video on Thursday showing pig iron being loaded, with a caption saying: “Operations at Murmansk port are in full swing: Changes to logistics in southern Russia have significantly increased cargo volumes here.” The port had announced on October 14 that it would handle pig iron shipments for the first time since 1996. The cargo is likely bound for Turkey; the European Union has banned imports of Russian pig iron since January 1 this year. Pig iron is a key raw material for the steel and cast-iron industries. Russia and Ukraine are the world’s two largest pig iron exporters after Brazil.

title: Russia to Export Pig Iron From Murmansk for First Time in 30 Years
